records.text: Andrew Kolvet told family and friends that he lost millions when Charlie Kirk declined Benjamin Netanyahu's proposal.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep eMtjzXkQrsU)

appearances.snippet: Andrew Kolvet, according to a family source of his, so this was a source that came to me, ... That he lost money. He lost millions when Charlie (Charlie Kirk) said no to taking Turning Point USA to the next level.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes this to an anonymous family source and uses allegedly. Live searches found no on-record family statement, financial document, proposal, or authenticated communication showing Kolvet said he lost millions. The private-source claim cannot be verified.

links.title: Family Source Says Kolvet Lost Millions
